# Prime Nest — Secure NestJS RBAC Template (JWT RS256)

> Reference NestJS backend for regulated, security-sensitive environments (fintech/healthtech/enterprise SaaS). Production-grade, security-hardened, TDD, audit-ready. Single-tenant. Built with intensive Claude Code assistance.

- Author: Ramos de Souza Janones — https://ramosdainformatica.com.br/ · https://www.linkedin.com/in/ramos-souza/ · https://github.com/RamosJSouza
- Repo language: TypeScript (NestJS). Bilingual docs: English + Português (PT-BR).
- Stack: NestJS · PostgreSQL + TypeORM · Redis (optional, shared cache + JWT denylist) · JWT RS256 · Class-Validator + Joi · Pino · Swagger.

## Core architecture

- Module flow is strictly unidirectional: Controller -> Service -> Repository. ORM/DB never imported at the Controller layer.
- Active AppModule imports: AuthModule, UsersModule, RbacModule, AuditModule, HealthModule, MaintenanceModule, GracefulShutdownModule, LoggerModule (+ OptionalBullModule when REDIS_HOST is set).
- TasksModule exists in code but is NOT imported by AppModule.
- Data model: User -> Role -> RolePermission -> Permission -> Feature. RBAC is database-driven (no hardcoded roles); changes take effect immediately.
- Route protection: JwtAuthGuard + PermissionGuard with @RequirePermissions('feature:action').

## Authentication & authorization

- JWT RS256: PRIVATE_KEY signs, PUBLIC_KEY verifies. Access token 15min, refresh token 7d with rotation + reuse detection.
- Payload: sub, email, roleId.
- JTI denylist in Redis (per access JTI, TTL 15min). Without REDIS_HOST, denylist is per-process in-memory.
- Password change revokes all user sessions. Account lockout: 5 failed attempts -> 15-minute lock.
- Guards (JwtAuthGuard, PermissionGuard) only do context extraction + permission checks via Reflector; no business logic or heavy DB queries inside guards.

## Database

- PostgreSQL + TypeORM (NOT Drizzle). Options in src/config/database.options.ts; CLI/migrations use src/config/typeorm.datasource.ts.
- Env vars use DB_* (not POSTGRES_*). synchronize disabled in production.
- Row-Level Security / tenant isolation: withTenant wrapper with WHERE organization_id clauses where RLS applies.

## Caching & RBAC performance

- RBAC permission cache key: rbac:role:{roleId}:permissions, TTL RBAC_CACHE_TTL (default 300000ms / 5min).
- Global invalidation epoch: rbac:global:epoch (no TTL, persisted in Redis) for cross-replica cache invalidation.
- Hot path getPermissionsForRole uses a single vectorized TypeORM QueryBuilder query (INNER JOIN rp -> permission -> feature) instead of find+relations, returning "featureKey:action" strings.
- Admin mutation invalidation is granular by role (invalidateRoles) for Permission update/remove; FeatureService keeps invalidateAllRoles (Feature.key change affects every role's cached strings).
- user:{sub} cache TTL 30s. jti:{accessJti} TTL 15min.

## Validation & error handling

- Global ValidationPipe with whitelist: true and forbidNonWhitelisted: true (prevents Mass Assignment).
- @ValidateNested() MUST be paired with @Type(() => DestinationClass). @Body() body: any is forbidden; DTOs require strong typing.
- Creation DTOs must not be recycled for updates; use PartialType() derivation.
- Silent error suppression (catch (e) { return null }) is forbidden. Emit semantic NestJS exceptions (NotFoundException, ConflictException, UnauthorizedException).
- Global Exception Filters sanitize stack traces in production.

## Key conventions

- DTOs in dto/. Entities in entities/. Guards in common/guards/.
- Repository layer: isolated data mappers; repositories MUST NOT import other repositories. Cross-repo orchestration belongs in Services.
- A Service with >8 constructor dependencies is a "God Object" -> refactor to Use-Case services.
- Swagger at /api/docs. Global API prefix defaults to /api (configurable via API_PREFIX).

## Main environment variables

- DB_* — PostgreSQL connection.
- PRIVATE_KEY, PUBLIC_KEY — RSA keys for JWT.
- REDIS_HOST, REDIS_PORT — cache, health, async audit (BullMQ); without Redis, audit uses synchronous fallback.
- PURGE_*, AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS, SESSION_GRACE_DAYS — purge crons (MaintenanceModule).
- PORT, NODE_ENV (development|production|test), ALLOWED_ORIGINS (required in production).

## Development commands

```
npm run dev               # dev with hot-reload
npm run build && npm run start:prod
npm test                  # all tests
npm test -- src/auth/auth.service.spec.ts   # single spec
npm run test:cov
npm run format && npm run lint
npm run schema:sync       # dev only
npm run migration:generate -- src/migrations/NomeMigracao
npm run migration:run
npm run migration:revert
npm run seed:rbac
npm run docker:up / npm run docker:down
```
